scope: One Fluent Bit 5.1.2 tail -> Lua filter -> Loki 3.5.0 path in the runner's disposable Kind cluster. It reads only four case-owned fixture lines: one synthetic request, one synthetic response, one benign positive record, and one malformed line. Green behavior covers only the literal synthetic patterns PERSON_[A-Z]+_[0-9]+ and KEY_[A-Z]+_[0-9]+ in the two allow-listed text fields, drops the fixture's customer_ref and auth_fragment fields, and preserves event_id, direction, model, status, elapsed_ms and scrubbed text. Malformed tail input is replaced with a fixed marker. This does not evaluate NER, general PII detection, nested/encoded payloads, production model or application collection, retention/access governance, forensic sampling, or non-payload operational logs. All fixture values are invented and non-sensitive; no external target, service, or credential is used.

checks.claim: With minimization absent, Loki stores both synthetic payload sentinels and structured sensitive fields
Loki stores exactly the allow-listed, pattern-masked request/response records; structured fields and malformed bytes are absent
Benign request record remains queryable with its permitted metadata and unchanged operational text
